items.name: Diamond Crest _Ring
items.description:
A wide-band geometric statement ring featuring a series of interconnected diamond-shaped panels arranged in a layered, lattice-like structure across the upper surface. The design is accentuated by delicate gold bead detailing along the panel borders, creating a textured and ornamental appearance.
The ring incorporates an open architectural framework beneath the upper design, consisting of intersecting structural bars that provide support while maintaining a lightweight visual construction. The diamond-shaped elements create a rhythmic pattern across the ring's circumference, with raised borders and decorative beaded edges adding depth and dimension.

items.name: Royal Letter_Tennis Bracelet
items.detailing: Blue Accent Stones in Letters (hanging)and Watch-Style Folding Clasp
items.style: Individual Diamond Channel with Two Initial Charms (A & R appear in reference)
items.description:
The bracelet incorporates a personalised two-letter initial charm attachment, featuring open-outline letter designs decorated with blue accent stones. The letter charms are suspended from two individual gold connecting loops, allowing them to hang freely beneath the main bracelet structure.
The bracelet is equipped with a rectangular watch-style clasp mechanism, incorporating a folding locking arrangement for secure fastening. The clasp is integrated into the diamond-set bracelet chain, maintaining a continuous and refined appearance.
The combination of brilliant-cut diamonds, personalised gemstone initials and a functional watch-style closure creates a contemporary luxury jewellery design.

items.name: Eternal Twist _ Ring
items.description:
A lightweight bridal diamond ring featuring an elegant interwoven crossover design. The upper portion consists of two flowing gold bands that cross over each other, creating a symmetrical twisted appearance.
Both crossover sections incorporate closely arranged small round brilliant-cut diamonds in continuous rows. The diamonds are secured using delicate gold bead-style settings, creating a micro-pavé appearance with decorative beaded borders.
The central crossover produces a subtle wave-like visual effect, while the polished gold edges frame the diamond rows and enhance their brilliance.
The ring maintains a slim, lightweight profile with a smooth inner shank, balancing ornamental detailing with everyday wearability.

items.name: Floral Cluster _Earing
items.design: Traditional-fusion jhumka featuring a floral cluster stud connected via a hinge/jump ring to a bell-shaped dome, adorned with intricate prong-set pink gemstones and a dense multi-row cluster of fine white pearls at the base .
items.detailing: Prong-set (normal) round brilliant pink stones (simulated pink sapphires/tourmalines) across the floral stud and dome upper tier; textured wire/prong accents, flower-shaped metal work, and a 3-row tightly clustered seed pearl fringe concealing base holes with a clean finish.
items.structure: Two-part articulated drop construction: upper floral stud module, connecting jump ring, and lower perforated bell jhumka dome with bottom pearl agglomeration .
items.description: Precision-engineered using Matrix 9 CAD software, this exquisite pair of Jhumka earrings showcases advanced 3D digital jewelry design. The upper stud features a radiant floral cluster composed of brilliant prong-set pink gemstones, linked seamlessly via an articulated jump ring to an intricately structured bell-shaped dome. The dome is detailed with matching pink stone accents and digital wirework, gracefully finished with a dense, luxurious fringe of clustered white pearls at the base that cleanly conceals the underlying geometry. Perfect for festive celebrations, weddings, and statement wear.
